0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, on a two-game losing streak, 13th in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs in the fifth game of the 2026-27 season for Utah, and they sit fifth in the Northwest, 3 games back. The Spurs are 1-2 and riding a one-game win streak, ranking 9th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Jazz lost 1-2 to San Antonio in 2025-26 and most recently lost 126-109 at home to them on January 22. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Jaren Jackson Jr., Jaxson Hayes and Lauri Markkanen are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
